# Fixture 57: long paragraph

Markdown is a lightweight markup language for creating formatted text. It is designed to be readable as plain text and convertible to HTML. This fixture contains a longer paragraph to exercise wrapping, punctuation, and mixed inline content. **Bold text** can appear mid-sentence, and *italic text* can follow. A [link](https://example.com) can sit at the end. The paragraph continues with Chinese text 中文排版和标点符号，以确保混排内容也能被正确解析。 Final sentence.
